cases.mechanism: Multiple HP branch-mask representations have equivalent proof semantics but produce distinct withdrawal exit identifiers.
cases.invariant: One semantic withdrawal must have one replay identity across all admissible representations.

cases.mechanism: Unframed concatenation of variable-width cache-key fields permitted different proof contexts to share one cache identity.
cases.invariant: A cache hit must only reuse proof validity under an equivalent complete verification context.

cases.mechanism: EIP-7702 admission and downstream block validity policy can disagree on the same transaction.
cases.invariant: Transaction admission must not create an unintended permanently invalid block or recurrent no-cost processing loop.

cases.mechanism: An uninitialized UUPS implementation had upgrade privileges separate from its initialized proxy.
cases.invariant: No lower-privilege user may acquire implementation-side authority to alter or destroy the deployed bridge logic.

cases.mechanism: Exact-out upscaling rounded toward the wrong side of the stable-swap invariant; rate-provider imprecision and low balances amplified an underpayment in batched swaps.
cases.invariant: Exact-out settlement must collect enough assets to preserve the pool invariant under supported rate scales and boundary states.

cases.mechanism: Leveraged position creation combined with reserve donation and subsequent liquidation exposed an accounting/collateralization inconsistency.
cases.invariant: Every operation sequence must maintain debt/collateral accounting constraints before and after liquidation.

cases.mechanism: Poisoned RPC observations and single-DVN configuration allowed a cryptographically valid attestation to describe an event that did not occur.
cases.invariant: Valid attestations must correspond to independently verified source-chain facts, not only authentic signatures from an incorrectly trusted observer.
